# Setup

This notebook walks through the full Heavy/Light serum-source analysis
step by step, so you can see (and re-run) every calculation. The **core
computation** comes from the `serumsource` R package; plotting, output
saving, report writing and notebook rendering come from the downstream
script (`downstream/downstream_analysis.R`).

```{r load-pkg, message=TRUE}
.libPaths(c(params$LIB_DIR, .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(serumsource)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})
cat("serumsource version :", as.character(packageVersion("serumsource")), "\n")
cat("Output directory    :", params$OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
cat("Input workbook      :", basename(params$INPUT_FILE), "\n")
```

---

# Parameters

The user-visible parameter object from `serumsource::serum_source_params()`
and the sample-to-column mapping used for this run.

```{r params}
input_file  <- params$INPUT_FILE
output_dir  <- params$OUTPUT_DIR
params_obj  <- if (inherits(params$PARAMS, "serum_source_params")) {
  params$PARAMS
} else {
  do.call(serum_source_params, params$PARAMS)
}
sample_info <- if (is.null(params$SAMPLE_INFO)) build_sample_info() else params$SAMPLE_INFO

print(params_obj)
cat("\nGroups to analyse:", paste(unique(sample_info$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Sample ↔ MaxQuant column mapping

```{r sample-map}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(sample_info)[, c("sample_id", "group",
                                 "light_column", "heavy_column",
                                 "peptide_column")],
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Sample mapping (en-dash MaxQuant column names)"
)
```

---

# Step 1 — Core computation

One function call runs the whole computation: reading, preparation,
background estimation, classification and source correction. No files are
written yet -- that happens in the downstream steps.

```{r step1-run, fig.show='hide', results='hold'}
start_time <- Sys.time()
core <- run_core_analysis(
  input_file      = input_file,
  sample_info     = sample_info,
  params          = params_obj
)
elapsed <- round(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"), 1)
cat("Core computation finished in", as.numeric(elapsed), "seconds.\n")
```

---

# Step 2 — Input & preparation

A quick look at what went in: how many proteins, how many
protein-replicate rows, and where the background noise floor landed.

```{r step2-shapes}
cat("Annotated proteins (rows)           :",
    formatC(nrow(core$annotation), format = "d", big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Per-protein / per-replicate rows    :",
    formatC(nrow(core$lh_long), format = "d", big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("UCEV proteins (SD estimate base)    :",
    formatC(length(unique(core$ucev_sd$Protein_Row_ID)),
            format = "d", big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Global Light-fraction SD floor      :",
    signif(core$global_fraction_sd_floor, 4), "\n")
```

# Step 3 — Classification summary

How many proteins fell into each classification bucket, per comparison
group (wide format: one column per bucket).

```{r step3-summary-wide}
cs <- as.data.frame(core$case_summary)
cs$protein_count <- as.integer(cs$protein_count)
wide <- reshape(
  cs[, c("comparison", "classification", "protein_count")],
  idvar     = "comparison",
  timevar   = "classification",
  direction = "wide"
)
names(wide) <- sub("^protein_count\\.", "", names(wide))
wide <- wide[order(wide$comparison), ]
for (cc in setdiff(names(wide), "comparison")) {
  wide[[cc]][is.na(wide[[cc]])] <- 0L
}
knitr::kable(wide, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Classification counts per comparison (wide)")
```

## Primary serum-derived protein counts

```{r step3-primary}
prim_count <- core$primary_serum %>%
  count(comparison, name = "Primary_serum_proteins")
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(prim_count), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Case breakdown by comparison and assigned case

```{r step3-case-long}
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(core$case_summary),
             row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Full case × classification breakdown")
```

# Step 4 — Visualisations

The downstream script provides the plotting functions. We source it here
and redraw every figure so you can inspect them directly in the notebook.
PNG copies of all these plots also live under `plots/` inside the output
directory.

```{r step4-source-downstream, message=TRUE}
# Locate the downstream script relative to this notebook
.ds_candidates <- c(
  file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "downstream_analysis.R"),
  file.path(params$OUTPUT_DIR, "downstream_analysis.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "downstream", "downstream_analysis.R")
)
.ds <- .ds_candidates[file.exists(.ds_candidates)][1]
if (is.na(.ds)) stop("Cannot find downstream_analysis.R")
source(.ds)
```

```{r step4-classification, fig.height=5.2}
plot_classification_summary(core$case_summary)
```

```{r step4-excess-dist, fig.height=6}
plot_excess_distribution(core$results)
```

```{r step4-excess-vs-prob, fig.height=5.8}
plot_excess_vs_probability(core$results)
```

```{r step4-serum-frac, fig.height=5.2}
plot_serum_fraction(core$primary_serum)
```

```{r step4-database, fig.height=5.0}
plot_database_evidence(core$primary_serum)
```

```{r step4-ucev-bg, fig.height=4.8}
plot_ucev_background(core$ucev_sd, core$global_fraction_sd_floor)
```

```{r step4-heatmap, fig.height=10}
plot_excess_heatmap(core$results)
```

# Step 6 — Top 10 serum candidates per group

The strongest candidates per group, ranked by Light-fraction excess, with
gene names, serum fractions and database evidence.

```{r step6-top10}
top10 <- core$primary_serum %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  arrange(desc(Light_fraction_excess), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    Group           = comparison,
    Gene            = Gene_names,
    Protein         = substr(Protein_IDs, 1, 40),
    Classification  = classification,
    `Light excess`  = round(Light_fraction_excess, 3),
    `Serum fraction`= round(estimated_serum_fraction, 3),
    `CV (serum fr.)`= round(serum_fraction_CV, 3),
    `Database`      = Database_evidence
  )
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(top10), row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Top 10 serum-derived candidates per comparison group, ranked by Light-fraction excess")
```
